title: Aspire Nexi One Vanilla Tobacco Prefilled Vape Pods - 20mg
description: Indulge in the smooth, sophisticated taste of Vanilla Tobacco with Aspire Nexi's prefilled pods. Each pod offers a unique blend flavours featuring rich tobacco and the sweet, creamy notes of vanilla, creating a luxuriously smooth vaping experience. These 20mg nicotine salt pods are perfect for those who enjoy a hint of sweetness with their traditional tobacco flavour, providing a balanced throat hit and effective nicotine delivery. The pack includes three pods, each with 1.2ml of e-liquid and designed to deliver up to 350 puffs. Featuring a 1.6ohm coil, the Nexi pods ensure a satisfying mouth-to-lung vaping experience reminiscent of smoking a traditional cigarette, but without the tar and ash. Effortless to use with the Aspire Nexi device, these pods ensure a clean, hassle-free vaping session without the need for refilling.
